{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module DNSResolver where

import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import Data.Word (Word32)
import Data.Char (toLower, isAlphaNum)
import Network.Socket
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (when, unless, forM_)
import Control.Exception (throwIO, userError)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, intercalate)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Connection pool for upstream DNS resolvers
data ConnPool = ConnPool
  { poolConns    :: MVar (Map.Map String Socket)
  , poolMaxSize :: Int
  , poolResolver :: String
  }

data DNSQuery = DNSQuery
  { qName  :: String
  , qType  :: String
  , qClass :: String
  } deriving (Show)

data DNSResponse = DNSResponse
  { rCode    :: Int
  , rAnswers :: [(String, String, Word32, String)]
  } deriving (Show)

-- Internal DNS cache
{-# NOINLINE dnsCache #-}
dnsCache :: IORef (Map.Map String DNSResponse)
dnsCache = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef Map.empty

-- Allowed resolver addresses (security policy)
allowedResolvers :: [String]
allowedResolvers = ["8.8.8.8", "8.8.4.4", "1.1.1.1", "1.0.0.1"]

-- Normalize domain name for cache lookup
normalizeDomain :: String -> String
normalizeDomain = map toLower . stripTrailingDot
  where
    stripTrailingDot s
      | not (null s) && last s == '.' = init s
      | otherwise = s

-- Validate that a domain name contains only safe characters
validateDomainName :: String -> Bool
validateDomainName name =
  let normalized = normalizeDomain name
      labels = splitOn '.' normalized
      validLabel l = not (null l) && length l <= 63 && all isValidChar l
      isValidChar c = isAlphaNum c || c == '-'
  in not (null labels) && all validLabel labels && length normalized <= 253

splitOn :: Char -> String -> [String]
splitOn _ [] = [""]
splitOn delim s =
  let (first, rest) = break (== delim) s
  in first : case rest of
    []     -> []
    (_:rs) -> splitOn delim rs

-- Check if address is internal/private (SSRF protection)
isInternalAddress :: String -> Bool
isInternalAddress addr =
  let parts = splitOn '.' addr
  in case map reads parts of
    [[(a,_)],[(b,_)],[(c,_)],[(d,_)]] ->
      let octets = (a,b,c,d) :: (Int,Int,Int,Int)
      in isPrivateRange octets
    _ -> True  -- If we can't parse it, treat as internal (deny by default)

isPrivateRange :: (Int,Int,Int,Int) -> Bool
isPrivateRange (a,b,_,_)
  | a == 10 = True
  | a == 172 && b >= 16 && b <= 31 = True
  | a == 192 && b == 168 = True
  | a == 127 = True
  | a == 0 = True
  | a == 169 && b == 254 = True
  | otherwise = False

-- Resolve CNAME chains with depth limit
resolveCNAMEChain :: ConnPool -> String -> Int -> IO (Either String DNSResponse)
resolveCNAMEChain pool name depth
  | depth > 10 = return $ Left "CNAME chain too deep"
  | otherwise = do
      result <- queryUpstream pool name "CNAME"
      case result of
        Left err -> return $ Left err
        Right resp -> do
          let cnames = [target | (_, "CNAME", _, target) <- rAnswers resp]
          case cnames of
            [] -> queryUpstream pool name "A"
            (target:_) -> do
              -- Follow CNAME - validate the target
              if validateDomainName target
                then resolveCNAMEChain pool target (depth + 1)
                else return $ Left "Invalid CNAME target"

-- Core resolution function with SSRF protection
resolveWithProtection :: ConnPool -> DNSQuery -> IO (Either String DNSResponse)
resolveWithProtection pool query = do
  let name = normalizeDomain (qName query)
  unless (validateDomainName name) $ error "Invalid domain name"
  
  -- Check cache first
  cache <- readIORef dnsCache
  case Map.lookup name cache of
    Just cached -> do
      -- Re-validate cached responses against internal addresses
      let aRecords = [addr | (_, "A", _, addr) <- rAnswers cached]
      let hasInternal = any isInternalAddress aRecords
      if hasInternal
        then do
          modifyIORef' dnsCache (Map.delete name)
          return $ Left "Cached resolution blocked: internal address"
        else return $ Right cached
    Nothing -> do
      -- Perform resolution
      result <- resolveCNAMEChain pool name 0
      case result of
        Left err -> return $ Left err
        Right resp -> do
          -- Validate resolved addresses are not internal
          let aRecords = [addr | (_, "A", _, addr) <- rAnswers resp]
          let hasInternal = any isInternalAddress aRecords
          if hasInternal
            then return $ Left "Resolution blocked: internal address"
            else do
              -- Cache and return
              modifyIORef' dnsCache (Map.insert name resp)
              return $ Right resp

-- Query upstream resolver via connection pool
queryUpstream :: ConnPool -> String -> String -> IO (Either String DNSResponse)
queryUpstream pool name qtype = do
  let resolver = poolResolver pool
  -- Verify resolver is in allowlist
  if resolver `elem` allowedResolvers
    then do
      conn <- getPooledConnection pool resolver
      sendDNSQuery conn name qtype
      response <- recvDNSResponse conn
      returnConnection pool resolver conn
      return $ Right response
    else return $ Left "Resolver not in allowlist"

-- Simulated network operations
getPooledConnection :: ConnPool -> String -> IO Socket
getPooledConnection pool addr = do
  conns <- takeMVar (poolConns pool)
  case Map.lookup addr conns of
    Just sock -> do
      putMVar (poolConns pool) (Map.delete addr conns)
      return sock
    Nothing -> do
      putMVar (poolConns pool) conns
      sock <- socket AF_INET Datagram defaultProtocol
      let hints = defaultHints { addrSocketType = Datagram }
      addrInfos <- getAddrInfo (Just hints) (Just addr) (Just "53")
      case addrInfos of
        (addrInfo:_) -> do
          connect sock (addrAddress addrInfo)
          return sock
        [] -> do
          close sock
          throwIO (userError ("No address info for resolver: " ++ addr))

returnConnection :: ConnPool -> String -> Socket -> IO ()
returnConnection pool addr sock = do
  conns <- takeMVar (poolConns pool)
  if Map.size conns < poolMaxSize pool
    then putMVar (poolConns pool) (Map.insert addr sock conns)
    else do
      putMVar (poolConns pool) conns
      close sock

sendDNSQuery :: Socket -> String -> String -> IO ()
sendDNSQuery sock name qtype = do
  let packet = BS.pack $ name ++ "\0" ++ qtype
  sendAll sock packet

recvDNSResponse :: Socket -> IO DNSResponse
recvDNSResponse sock = do
  buf <- recv sock 512
  return $ parseDNSResponse buf

parseDNSResponse :: BS.ByteString -> DNSResponse
parseDNSResponse _ = DNSResponse 0 []

-- Public API: resolve a domain with full SSRF protection
resolveDomain :: ConnPool -> String -> IO (Either String [(String, Word32)])
resolveDomain pool domain = do
  let query = DNSQuery domain "A" "IN"
  result <- resolveWithProtection pool query
  case result of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right resp -> return $ Right [(addr, ttl) | (_, "A", ttl, addr) <- rAnswers resp]

-- Initialize a new connection pool
newPool :: String -> IO ConnPool
newPool resolver = do
  conns <- newMVar Map.empty
  return $ ConnPool conns 10 resolver

-- Batch resolution with connection reuse
resolveBatch :: ConnPool -> [String] -> IO [(String, Either String [(String, Word32)])]
resolveBatch pool domains = do
  results <- mapM (\d -> do
    r <- resolveDomain pool d
    return (d, r)) domains
  return results
